notes.title: Version 1.17 now live
notes.notes:
Version 1.17 now live 

New features: 
------------------------------------------------- 
New simple map. Changes the base map art. Hit the '9' key in the main game map mode to activate.

Revised mini map. Changed it to fit the lower bar scheme and made clearer so agents & locations stand out more.

Added Steam Avatars. You can now use Cults & Daggers portraits as your Steam avatar.

--------------------------------------------------- 
Tuning: 
Minor tweak on beggars increasing chance to gain money.
 
--------------------------------------------------- 

Enjoy the game and save the soul of the world!

notes.title: Version 1.16 now live
notes.notes:
Version 1.16 now live

New features: 
------------------------------------------------- 
Two new special disciples. They show up along with all other specials if you have a particularly effective recruiting action. 

"Low Born" disciples, these special disciples are better at hiding and the rough and tumble of travel in the ancent world. 

"Philosopher" disciples. Better at all things oratory and have the ability to reduce the success of enemy cults occult dabblings in their city. 
--------------------------------------------------- 
Tuning: 
Slightly adjusted the murder curve through the first two ages. The game should be a bit more brutal and less forgiving to ALL sides (including the AI). 
--------------------------------------------------- 
Performance: 

Carried over and improved upon from 1.15 
Significant overall of asset loading & caching. 
Complete overall of all in game assets. Streamlined just about all of them. The footprint for the game is now a few hundred meg smaller. This should have s direct impact on lower end video cards. 
--------------------------------------------------- 

Enjoy the game and save the soul of the world!

notes.title: Version 1.15 now in beta channel
notes.notes:
Version 1.15 now in beta channel

This version is entirely focused on performance on lower end cards  and fixing the "black map" bug. Feel free to ignore it if you are not having any problems. There are no gameplay changes in this beta build.

- Asset optimization
- Changed code to address the "black map" bug which impacts a couple of customers.
- Shift + M in game forces map reload
- Rewritten several load & save routines to make graphics memory more efficient.
- Minor performance tweaks

To access this build please pick the beta branch (right click on Cults & Daggers then properties & betas). 

Thank you!

notes.title: Version 1.13 now live
notes.notes:
Version 1.13 now live 

Cults City summary screen. Now supports click to scroll. Click on icon to scroll to that city.

Cults City summary screen. Now shows which cities are at war.

New Miracle - Reveal enemies. Removes level*10 of hidden level of all other Cults disciples.

Various gameplay tuning issues for the first three Ages including less skill failures early on.

Tuned down very slightly the bad events for Disciples.

New rendering mode used. I tweaked the opengl settings to be a bit broader. Although I am keeping the system specs as is for now the game should now run on some lower non min spec cards. I will let that bake for a while before potentially reducing the games min specs.

If you have had issues starting the game in full screen please continue to use the beta branch (right click on Cults & Daggers then properties & betas). 

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Version 1.12 now live
notes.notes:
Version 1.12 now live 

Reformats the news feed to remove the rumours messages in the single player campaign game. This should help improve usability and reduce clutter in single player games where you are not keeping track on other players activity levels.

Added a Cults City summary button. This tracks your money, believers and number of Disciples across all cities at a glance.

Many formatting changes to help readability.

Smoothed out the occult curve in the late game.

If you have had issues starting the game in full screen please continue to use the beta branch (right click on Cults & Daggers then properties & betas).

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: version 1.10 now live
notes.notes:
version 1.10 now live
New bold font now used by default

New disciple ability - "beggar" adds 1-5 silver per month in the city where the disciple is located. This happens automatically regardless of other actions.

New disciple ability - "robber" adds 25 to the chance of a successful robbery in a city, cumulative with other robbers

Backend changes to the news events system. You should see now change until the next push but it is part of the GUI tweaks I am implementing.

More tweaks to help with remaining couple of graphics cards. Changed the initialization routine.

If you have had issues starting the game in full screen please continue to use the beta branch (right click on Cults & Daggers then properties & betas).

notes.title: Version 1.04 live
notes.notes:
New build of Cults & Daggers 1.04 is now live

SAVE GAME RESET: As part of the data change some users will have had their save games in progress reset. This should not occur again going forward.

Update notes: 

Added cursor toggle keys 'p' & 'o'

Added new disciple events:
intervene to help an innocent being attacked in the streets
give a stirring funeral oration
befriends a local noble
sees the sprit world

Tweaked these events:
reduced the chance of death by mob, 
reduced the chance of Disciples (even as monsters) falling in love (for Valentines day as well, for shame)


Killing ability changed so a high killing skill does not also make one so invulnerable to attack
Age 4 special events slightly adjusted down
Some typo fixes
Removed debug commands from main build
Memory reduction work continues for those on certain vid cards, (this will be ongoing over the next few days, hang in there!)

If you have had issues starting the game in full screen please continue to use the beta branch (right click on Cults & Daggers then properties & betas)
